_comment: Reference values for qe-bands-si (QE 7.4 conda-forge build hac89879_0, PBE, Si diamond 2-atom cell celldm(1)=10.26, ecutwfc=40/ecutrho=320, scf 4x4x4 shifted grid, bands nbnd=8 on Gamma->X tpiba with 21 k-points, eigenvalues from outdir/pwscf.xml converted Ha->eV with 27.211386245988). Calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: 5 oracle runs produced identical values at 1e-6 eV (spread 0); full scf+bands+bands.x pipeline ~7 s. VBM at Gamma (6.210795 eV), CBM at k=(0.85,0,0) tpiba (6.783513 eV) -> indirect gap 0.572718 eV, the expected PBE Si result (experimental 1.17 eV, PBE underestimates). Reference tolerance 0.005 eV accommodates agents reporting bands.dat's 3-decimal print precision; the XML re-derivation (L4) is the primary anti-forgery layer and uses 0.01 eV. bands.dat double source uses 0.002 eV (both sides at most 3-decimal rounding apart).
